criteria.statement: One verified digest binds to multiple agents while retaining one provenance record.
Cross-tenant bindings and conflicting digest provenance fail closed.
Rollback lookup returns the exact previous append-only binding.
Upgrade and dependency-safe downgrade migrations remain embedded.
Nostr projections preserve provenance, branch, channel, tenant, agent, service, and rollback linkage without workspace conflation.
HTTP reads pass tenant and rollback selectors to the model.
